about.title: Get to know us
about.desc_1: Protect what you value most with experts in closed-circuit television system installation for homes and businesses in Bogotá and the Sabana. We implement cutting-edge technology solutions with wireless cameras, solar-powered systems, and traditional equipment, adapting to every need. We provide personalized advice, install and configure the app on your phone so you can monitor your property from anywhere, and provide ongoing follow-up to guarantee reliable, close service and support that continues long after installation.
about.why_subtitle: Coverage in Bogotá and Sabana, real post-sale support, and straightforward pricing.

home.hero_subtitle: Security camera sales and professional installation in Bogotá & Sabana region
home.features_1_desc: Certified technicians with experience in CCTV, networks, and electrical systems.
home.features_2_desc: We reach over 20 municipalities in Cundinamarca at no extra cost.
home.features_3_desc: Manufacturer warranty on equipment plus backed labor warranty.
home.features_4_desc: We commit to service quality and you enjoy the peace of mind of being protected.
home.faq_1_a: Choose your combo, accept the terms, pay 50% via Wompi, and pay the balance on delivery day.
home.faq_2_a: We cover Bogotá D.C. and Sabana de Bogotá municipalities. If your area isn't listed, message us on WhatsApp.
home.faq_3_a: Camera mounting, cable routing (wired systems), DVR/NVR setup, WiFi connection, and function testing.
home.faq_4_a: Equipment warranty is per manufacturer. Labor warranty coverage is shown on each combo.
home.how_1_desc: Browse our catalog or answer a few questions and we'll recommend the best combo for you.
home.how_2_desc: Pay the deposit via Wompi (card, PSE or Nequi) and secure your installation.
home.how_3_desc: We'll contact you within 24 hours to coordinate the installation date and time.
home.how_4_desc: On installation day, pay the remaining balance, verify everything works, and you're done.
